title: Tsunami
tldr: Near the coast, strong or long shaking, a sudden unusual sea rise or retreat, or a loud ocean roar can signal a tsunami. After shaking stops, move to high ground and inland immediately. Do not wait for an official warning when natural warning signs are present.
steps: Drop, Cover and Hold On first if the earthquake is still occurring.
Move uphill and inland along the designated route, on foot if roads are blocked.
Never go to watch waves or exposed seabed.
Stay out of the evacuation zone until authorities say it is safe.
next: Know coastal evacuation routes before visiting. Use designated vertical evacuation structures where local plans provide them.
watch: The first wave may not be largest. Dangerous currents can last for hours.
